stories.title: US–Canada 50% Tariffs Live After Talks Collapse at Last Minute
stories.what: US–Canada trade negotiations collapsed at the deadline. 50% tariffs on $20B in Canadian goods took effect at 12:01am. A draft deal had been close — US lowers steel/aluminum/auto tariffs, Canada drops retaliatory measures — but negotiators couldn't close it. PM Carney: Canada retaliates 'dollar for dollar.'

steps.text: US-Canada talks collapse at midnight deadline
50% tariff activates on Canadian steel, aluminum, autos, lumber
tariff = tax on US importers not Canada — US companies pay the 50%
Canadian input costs rise 50% for US manufacturers
manufacturers absorb margin hit OR raise prices — consumer inflation gets new input

so_what: Tariffs are a domestic tax — US importers pay the 50%, not Canada.
Bearish: US auto/lumber/steel manufacturers with Canadian supply chains face margin squeeze.
Watch: Canadian energy stocks for oversold bounce if a deal gets done eventually.

stories.title: Ray Dalio: Bessent's Bond Buyback Is a Debt Crisis Signal — Buy Gold and Bitcoin
stories.what: Ray Dalio told CNBC that Treasury Secretary Bessent's bond buyback intervention is 'a sign a debt crisis is getting closer,' not a fix. JPMorgan called it 'paying your mortgage with your credit card.' Yields rebounded by end of week, erasing all intervention gains. SA: 'Worst bond selloff since 2007.'

steps.text: Treasury issues massive bond supply — more than buyers want
bond prices fall, yield rises (yield = coupon ÷ price, inverse)
all long-term borrowing anchored to it gets expensive — mortgages, corporate debt, consumer loans
total debt ($40T) unchanged — buying old debt with new debt solves nothing
yields rebound by end of week — market saw through it

so_what: Buying back debt with new debt does not reduce the total — it just moves the problem.
Build real-asset allocation now: gold and Bitcoin are fixed-supply hedges against currency debasement.
Watch Jackson Hole — any Powell hike signal reprices high-multiple AI names hard.

price_moves.reason: long-duration bond ETF — hurt most by yield spike
Dalio recommends gold as debt crisis hedge
fixed supply hedge, best week in 2yr
DCF-sensitive; if Jackson Hole hawkish → repricing risk

stories.title: Anthropic IPO Filing Will List 'AI Backlash' as SEC Risk Factor — $852B Valuation
stories.what: CNBC exclusive: Anthropic's upcoming IPO filing will explicitly list AI backlash as a material business risk — the first major AI company to formally disclose societal resistance to AI in an SEC filing. Current valuation: $852B at employee tender offer. Public listing may not arrive until 2027.

mechanism.chain: Anthropic IPO draft filed → lawyers must list material risks → AI backlash qualifies → SEC disclosure sets industry precedent

so_what: SEC risk factor = legal admission this could materially harm revenue, not just PR noise.
Two-sided: bearish on sector valuation headwind, bullish that disclosure signals institutional-grade governance.
Watch the actual prospectus language — regulators will use it as a leverage point against AI companies.

price_moves.reason: owns 49% of OpenAI; AI backlash risk factor affects whole sector

stories.title: Tesla Cybercab Fully Driverless in Austin + Chinese Robot Beats Usain Bolt's 100m Record
stories.what: Tesla's Austin Cybercab robotaxis are confirmed fully driverless — tracking data shows no safety driver present in operating vehicles, ahead of the end-of-August public launch event. Separately, a Chinese humanoid robot beat Usain Bolt's 100m world record of 9.58 seconds in a test run. Waymo revealed the hardware/software 'brain' powering its robotaxi fleet.

mechanism.chain: Cybercab removes safety driver + Chinese robot breaks Bolt 100m record same week  → safety driver was the legal buffer between Tesla and full liability (without it, Tesla accepts that the car can operate autonomously with no human fallback)  → 9.58s barrier crossed because AI servo motors can optimize stride length and frequency beyond human physiological limits  → both events = physical AI crossing human-level benchmarks simultaneously in mobility and locomotion  → same inflection as AlphaGo in 2016: once barrier breaks, acceleration follows

so_what: No safety driver = regulatory threshold crossed; Tesla is accepting full autonomous liability.
Bullish Tesla robotaxi; bearish Uber/Lyft on 3-5yr horizon as robotaxi undercuts human-driven economics.
Watch whether Waymo matches fully-driverless publicly — that confirms the competitive race is on.

price_moves.reason: fully driverless confirmed — robotaxi thesis advancing
robotaxi at scale is structural threat to rideshare 3-5yr horizon

stories.title: Ghost Jobs: 1 in 5 Listings Are Fake — Lawmakers Moving to Ban Them, Texas Goes After LinkedIn
stories.what: Roughly 1 in 5 online job listings per quarter are ghost jobs — postings that attract applicants but lead to no hiring. 81% of recruiters admit their employers post fake listings. New York just passed a bill requiring hiring timelines. Texas AG Ken Paxton opened an investigation into LinkedIn for allegedly promoting and profiting from ghost job listings.

mechanism.chain: 1 in 5 listings are ghost jobs → Texas AG targets LinkedIn → platform liability shifts → job board economics change

so_what: Texas going after LinkedIn shifts liability from employer to platform — changes the incentive structure.
Bullish: verification-first job platforms (charge per verified hire, not per listing) get a regulatory tailwind.
Actionable for job seekers: cold applications to platforms have 1-in-5 hit rate — prioritize referral networks.

stories.title: Iran: Selective Hormuz Openings + New US Sanctions + Xi–Trump Meeting Imminent
stories.what: Iran granted permission for Iraqi oil tankers to pass through Hormuz — a selective, tactical opening. Tough new US sanctions on Iran are imminent. JD Vance: 'economic pressure is the best way to achieve objectives in Iran.' US Navy transited Taiwan Strait immediately before a planned Xi–Trump meeting. Seoul's Incheon Airport became the world's busiest international hub, overtaking Dubai which collapsed after the Iran war started.

mechanism.chain: Iran opens Hormuz for Iraq only → selective lever not binary blockade → new US sanctions incoming → UAE trade cut

so_what: Selective Hormuz opening for Iraq only = precision leverage, not binary blockade — Iran is still in control.
Oil stays bid; Korean Air/Asiana structurally benefit from rerouted international traffic through Seoul.
Watch Xi-Trump meeting — any US-China Iran agreement immediately changes the oil supply calculus.

price_moves.reason: oil stays bid as Hormuz stays selectively controlled
